quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 annual report: on December 9, 2025 Sugon's board approved terminating the major asset restructuring under which Hygon Information Technology would have absorbed Sugon through a share swap with all Sugon A-share holders (plus matching fundraising), a plan the board had first approved on June 6, 2025. The company said the large, multi-party deal took a long time to settle, the market environment had changed substantially since planning began and the conditions were not yet mature, so it ended the deal after consulting the parties.
